profile.headline: Flight Software Engineer at Jet Propulsion Laboratory
profile.summary:
I am a computer scientist focused on developing flight software for satellites and interplanetary spacecraft.  I have a background in the fields of high performance computing, microprocessor architecture, and computational genetics.  I am also strongly interested in the practical application of computer science principles and theory in a corporate setting or as part of an entrepreneurial venture.

Specialties: spacecraft flight software
computational biology and bioinformatics 
algorithms development
high performance computing and parallel architectures
interdisciplinary project organization
C, C++, Python, and Java programming 
iPhone application development

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Designing, prototyping, and developing telemetry collection, data management, and downlink portions of a time and space partitioned flight software framework for the Europa Clipper mission
• Drafting  middleware requirements for a next-generation ARM-based, scalable, multicore, multi-processor, low-power spacecraft avionics platform
• Built large-scale, browser-based, telemetry visualization tools as a member of the Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) project Flight Operations Team (FOT) through the use of Elasticsearch, Bootstrap, and D3 technologies
• Supported SMAP Assembly, Test, and Launch Operations (ATLO) as a spacecraft test engineer
• Developed data management and downlink, 1553 bus controller, and instrument flight software for SMAP
• Created utilities for the Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) project to decode flight software data products
• Contributed to a fractioned spacecraft project funded by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA)
• Designing, coding, modifying, testing, and debugging complex embedded software
• Programming in C, C++, JavaScript, Python, XSLT, and Bash

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Developed novel algorithms to cluster and analyze genetic data 
• Learned to understand and debug highly complex recursive code
• Mastered and applied principles in computational genetics, machine learning, and statistical modeling 
• Worked as part of an interdisciplinary team that is contributing to a multi-million dollar medical research project 
• Programmed in C, C++, Python, and R

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Led discussion sections, helped students with homework, and graded exams and assignments for computer science 33.  This course focused on assembly language programming and low-level processor architecture.

positions.title: English Instructor
positions.description:
•	Taught English to students in Japan 
•	Developed leadership skills through classroom management
•	Gained experience communicating across cultural boundaries

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
•	Assisted in the development of an innovative power measurement system for compute clusters
•	Debugged and modified power optimizing software for HPC systems
•	Customized benchmark codes to manually throttle CPU voltage hundreds of times per minute over multiple processors
•	Programmed in C and Java

honors.title: NASA Early Career Achievement Medal
honors.description: This medal is awarded to any government employee for unusual and significant performance during the first 10 years of an individual’s career in support of the agency. Performance is characterized by unusual initiative or a creative achievement that clearly demonstrates a significant contribution in the individual’s discipline area that directly contributes to NASA’s mission and goals. The contribution is significant, in that, for an employee who is at such an early phase of career, the contribution has substantially improved the discipline area.

honors.title: 2013 NASA Software of the Year
honors.description: Was a member of the Mars Curiosity Rover flight software team, which received a 2013 NASA Software of the Year group award.
